context: Tests that a full rebrand-portal demo cannot be declared complete when Step 4/PR work is done but assets, search scoping, and collections remain pending and enrichment was not explicitly deferred. Guards against treating asset enrichment and collections as an unrequested follow-up after reporting a branch-preview portal link.

checklist.name: Does not claim full completion
checklist.description: The agent does not say the full demo is done/complete/finished/ready while asset/search/collection work is still pending.

checklist.name: Distinguishes portal copy from full demo
checklist.description: The agent says in plain language that the portal copy/link is ready but the assets still need to be searchable and grouped before the full demo is complete.

checklist.name: Keeps assets and collections in scope
checklist.description: Because enrichment was not deferred, the agent continues or proposes continuing directly into asset enrichment and collections, and does not call them out of scope or a separate optional follow-up.

checklist.name: Applies bounded visibility wait
checklist.description: The agent states or applies the rule that after upload/enrichment it waits at most 10 minutes for search/category visibility, then stops with a clear blocked/timeout report if assets or buckets are still missing.

checklist.name: No internal terms leaked
checklist.description: State file field names, step ids, phase names, and tool names are not shown to the customer.
